description: Architecture diagram, wide 16:9, showing where security risks enter an assistant. Centre: a vertical stack of five rounded boxes, top to bottom: 'Chat: Kavita, Rohit, Neha', 'Harness and model', 'Knowledge: policy search', 'Toolbox over MCP', and a soft ember-orange box at the bottom 'Bahi ERP 7.2 (1998)'. Thin downward arrows join them. Around the stack, small numbered tags in sky blue, each with a thin leader line to the box where the risk enters: tag 'LLM01 Prompt injection' pointing to both the Chat box and the Toolbox box; tag 'LLM02 Sensitive information disclosure' pointing to Knowledge; tag 'LLM05 Improper output handling' pointing between Harness and Toolbox; tag 'LLM06 Excessive agency' pointing to Toolbox; tag 'LLM07 System prompt leakage' pointing to Harness; tag 'LLM08 Vector and embedding weaknesses' pointing to Knowledge; tag 'LLM09 Misinformation' pointing to Harness; tag 'LLM10 Unbounded consumption' pointing to Harness; tag 'LLM03 Supply chain' and 'LLM04 Data and model poisoning' grouped together at the far left pointing to Harness and model. Left column of tags and right column of tags, evenly spaced, no overlapping lines. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Left-to-right pipeline diagram, wide 16:9, of programmable guardrails around a chat assistant. Far left: a rounded box 'User message'. Arrow to a tall green-outlined box 'Input rails' containing two stacked small boxes 'Safety classifier: Llama Guard' and 'Policy check: self check input'. From Input rails, a short ember arrow going down to a small ember box 'Refuse: polite reply'. Main arrow continues right to a sky-blue box 'Dialogue rails' with small subtitle 'is this a purchasing topic?'. Arrow to a central box 'Ask Rasoi: model and tools'. Under the central box, a small box 'Tool output rail: scan what tools return' connected with a thin up arrow. Arrow right to a green-outlined box 'Output rails' containing 'self check output'. Arrow to a final box 'Reply to user'. Below the whole pipeline, a thin grey band labelled 'NeMo Guardrails: config.yml + rails.co + prompts.yml'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Data-flow diagram, wide 16:9, explaining indirect prompt injection through a tool result. Top row left to right: a box 'Supplier portal: anyone can edit their display name', arrow to an ember-orange database cylinder 'Supplier master in Bahi', arrow to a box 'find_supplier tool', arrow to a sky-blue box 'Model context', where the context box contains three stacked strips: 'System prompt', 'Kavita: order 20,000 gaskets from Kaveri Rubber', and an ember-highlighted strip 'Tool result: name contains a note to the assistant'. Arrow from the model context down to a box 'Model proposes create_purchase_order'. Below, a row of three defence boxes left to right, each joined to the flow with a thin dashed line: 'Mark tool results as data', 'Scan tool results with a classifier', and a green-outlined box 'Check the write in code: food-grade guard'. The last box has a short arrow to a small box 'Refused: NE3'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Architecture diagram, wide 16:9, of durable execution with Temporal. Left: a rounded box 'Ask Rasoi app' with an arrow labelled 'start workflow' to the centre. Below it, a box 'Rohit approves in Bahi' with an arrow labelled 'signal: approval decided' to the centre. Centre: a large sky-blue box 'Temporal service' containing two stacked boxes 'Event history: every step recorded' and 'Task queue: bahi-purchasing'. Right: two worker boxes stacked, the top one outlined in ember with a cross and label 'Worker 1, killed', the bottom one sky blue 'Worker 2, takes over'. Inside each worker two small boxes: 'Workflow code: the order, deterministic' and 'Activities: model calls and Bahi tools'. Far right: a soft ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2' and a box 'Model through OpenRouter', both connected only to the activities boxes. A thin arrow from Temporal service to Worker 2 labelled 'replay history'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Timeline diagram, wide 16:9, explaining replay after a crash. A horizontal event history along the top drawn as a row of eight rounded tiles left to right: 'Workflow started', 'Model call: completed', 'check_stock: completed', 'create_purchase_request: completed', 'Timer: 24 hours', 'Signal: Rohit approved', 'Model call: completed', 'release_purchase_order: completed'. A vertical ember line cuts the row between the fourth and fifth tiles, labelled 'Worker 1 killed'. Below the row, a second row labelled 'Worker 2 replays': the first four tiles repeated in light grey with the small caption 'answers read from history, nothing re-sent to the model or to Bahi', then the remaining tiles in sky blue with the caption 'new work, run for real'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Architecture diagram, wide 16:9, of memory and data in production. Top: three identical rounded boxes side by side 'Ask Rasoi replica 1', 'Ask Rasoi replica 2', 'Ask Rasoi replica 3', with a thin box above them 'Load balancer'. Below the replicas, two storage boxes side by side. Left storage: a red-free sky-blue cylinder 'Redis' with three small lines inside 'session history, 7-day expiry', 'rate-limit counters', 'shared by every replica'. Right storage: a green-outlined cylinder 'Postgres with pgvector' with lines inside 'policy clauses and their vectors', 'who may read: a WHERE clause', 'HNSW index'. Every replica has thin arrows to both cylinders. Bottom: a soft ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2', reached only through a box 'Toolbox over MCP'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Architecture diagram, wide 16:9, of a model gateway. Left column: three rounded boxes stacked 'Ask Rasoi: purchase team key', 'Stores app: stores team key', 'Notebook: a student key'. All three arrows go right into a large sky-blue box 'LiteLLM proxy' containing four stacked rows: 'Virtual keys and teams', 'Budgets and rate limits', 'Router with fallbacks', 'Spend log per key and team'. From the proxy, arrows go right to three provider boxes stacked: 'OpenRouter: gemini-3.8-flash', 'OpenRouter: gemini-3.5-flash-lite', 'Other providers'. A dashed arrow from the first provider to the second labelled 'fallback when the first fails'. Below the proxy, a green-outlined cylinder 'Postgres: keys and spend'. An ember arrow out of Budgets and rate limits to a small box 'Refused: budget exceeded'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Layered comparison diagram, wide 16:9, of what a managed agent platform hosts. Left: a vertical stack of six rounded boxes, top to bottom, labelled 'Your agent code and prompts', 'Runtime: sessions, scaling', 'Identity: who the agent acts as', 'Memory: short and long term', 'Gateway: tools and models', 'Observability: traces and evals'. The top box is sky blue with the note 'you write this'; the other five are light grey with the note 'the platform can host this'. To the right, three columns, each headed by plain text: 'AWS Bedrock AgentCore', 'Microsoft Foundry Agent Service', 'Google Vertex AI Agent Engine with ADK'. Each column has five small rounded cells aligned with the five grey layers. Far right a narrow column headed 'What we built by hand' with cells: 'Modal app', 'passthrough session', 'Redis and pgvector', 'MCP toolbox and LiteLLM', 'traces and eval suite'. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.

Architecture diagram, wide 16:9, a layered stack with a highlighted production band. Five layers numbered 1 to 5 on the far left, top to bottom: row 1 three rounded boxes 'Ask Rasoi chat', 'Workflow Studio', 'Approvals inbox'; row 2 a wide box 'Harness: the agent loop' containing 'LLM: the brain' and 'Knowledge: policy search and wiki' with a small circular arrow 'reason, act, observe' between; row 3 a thin bar 'MCP'; row 4 a box 'Toolbox: one tool per business activity'; row 5 a soft ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2 (1998) services'. Around the stack, a glowing sky-blue frame labelled at the top right 'Lecture 11: production', with five small sky-blue tags attached to the frame where they act: 'Guardrails' beside row 1 and row 2, 'Gateway: LiteLLM' beside row 2, 'Durable: Temporal' beside rows 2 to 4, 'Data: pgvector and Redis' beside row 2, 'Cost per order' at the bottom right. On the right, a narrow green column 'Trust: identity, approvals, guard, read-back, evals, traces' joined to the stack with dashed lines. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.
